evidence.source: Academia Sinica, International Computer Chinese Character and Variant Database
evidence.field: Character-specific graphic interpretation; script labels; bronze inscription citation
evidence.text: The 先 record presents oracle-bone, bronze, Chu-slip, and small-seal categories, labels a bronze example 集成02812, and interprets the old form as a person below with a foot above, expressing going ahead of others. Its text does not establish a complete lineage into modern 先.
evidence.title: 漢字「先」：字形演變

evidence.source: Luo Kun, 殷墟卜辭中的「先」與「失」
evidence.field: Shang graph identification and competing readings
evidence.text: The study distinguishes the graph read as 先, analyzed as 止 plus 人, from a similar graph with disputed readings including 失 or 姺/name. This dispute concerns the other graph and does not establish corruption in 先.
evidence.title: 殷墟卜辭中的「先」與「失」

evidence.field: File description, original file, label, source, reuse rights
evidence.text: The exact description page identifies 先-oracle.svg as a vector depiction of 先 in oracle-script style, gives the related hanziyuan.net record as j20829, lists Sinica Database and other character databases as sources, shows an original SVG file, and states public-domain status with attribution appreciated but not required. This is modern digital artwork, not an excavated inscription photograph.
evidence.title: File:先-oracle.svg

evidence.field: File description, original file, label, source, reuse rights
evidence.text: The exact description page identifies ACC-s06218.svg as a vector depiction of 先 in Shuowen seal-script style, cites the Sinica Database and other character resources, identifies the specific hanziyuan record s06218, shows an original SVG file, and states public-domain status with attribution appreciated but not required. This is a modern digital redraw, not an ancient artifact image.
evidence.title: File:ACC-s06218.svg

evidence.field: File description, original file, label, provenance, rights
evidence.text: The exact description page identifies 先-seal.svg as a vector depiction of 先 in Shuowen seal-script style; its filename and description connect it with 先-seal-s06218. It lists character-data sources and states public-domain status with attribution appreciated but not required. This modern redraw overlaps in form category with ACC-s06218, so it adds little for showing developmental change.
evidence.title: File:先-seal.svg

evidence.field: File description, original file, label, source, reuse rights
evidence.text: The exact description page identifies 先 in Shang oracle-script style and shows an original SVG file. It describes the image as a public-domain depiction of ancient script; attribution is not required but appreciated. The file is a modern vector redraw, not an artifact photograph.
evidence.title: File:ACC-j20851.svg

evidence.source: Academia Sinica, 小學堂文字學資料庫
evidence.field: Copyright notice for query-interface glyph images and glyph-attribute information
evidence.text: The rights notice states that glyph images and glyph-attribute information obtained through its query interface are dedicated under CC0 1.0 within the scope of applicable copyright law. No specific 先 image was selected here.
evidence.title: 版權聲明

search_audit.query: 先 oracle bone bronze graph Academia Sinica 先 evolution; site:commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File: ACC-s06218.svg 先; site:commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File: "先-oracle.svg"; site:commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File: "Shuowen Seal Radical 316.svg"
search_audit.outcome: Search located Commons file pages and the institutional evolution record; opened Sinica’s record. Initial Commons direct opens failed with cache errors.

search_audit.query: Commons imageinfo API exact files ACC-s06218.svg, 先-oracle.svg, Shuowen Seal Radical 316.svg; Xiaoxuetang CC0 notice
search_audit.outcome: Commons API requests were inaccessible through the web tool. The Xiaoxuetang rights notice opened and confirmed CC0 1.0 for query-interface glyph images and glyph attributes.

search_audit.query: "ACC-s06218.svg" 先 seal file Commons; "先-oracle.svg" Wikimedia Commons Shang oracle script file history; "先-seal.svg" Wikimedia Commons Shuowen seal
search_audit.outcome: Search-result page content exposed the exact Commons descriptions, original-file listings, image labels, provenance leads, and rights statements. Selected an oracle-script and a seal-script candidate; did not select a duplicate seal redraw.

gaps: Commons exact description pages were established through indexed page content, but the web tool's direct Commons opens failed with cache errors and the exact-file imageinfo API calls were inaccessible. The search-result page content did expose original SVG listings and reuse terms.
The selected files are modern vector redraws; neither is a photograph of an artifact. Individual oracle-bone artifact dates are not supplied by these image records.
The Sinica character-evolution text gives a broad foot-and-person interpretation and categories, but does not establish a complete graphic lineage into modern 先.
The local candidate pixels were available in the workspace, but were not visually inspected in this research stage; image identity and selection rest on exact Commons description-page content.

items.period: Shang oracle-script tradition; individual artifact date not specified
items.caption: Modern redraw of an oracle-script form identified as 先; the record links it to source form j20829.
items.alt: A single dark oracle-script form of 先, reproduced as a modern vector drawing.
items.selection_reason: Shows the early script category relevant to the Shang graph analysis and person-plus-foot interpretation; description identifies the graph and supplies its source-record label.
items.rights: Public domain statement on the file page; attribution is not required but appreciated.

items.period: Small-seal / Shuowen tradition; no individual artifact date stated
items.caption: Modern redraw of the Shuowen seal-script form of 先, identified by the source page with record s06218.
items.alt: A single seal-script form of 先 shown as a modern vector drawing.
items.selection_reason: Pairs an early-script candidate with the later seal-script category documented in the paleographic record; illustrates script-category difference without implying a complete lineage.
items.rights: Public domain statement on the file page; attribution is not required but appreciated.

limitations.text: These candidates are modern redrawings rather than photographs of excavated artifacts. Their script-style labels are source-page classifications; they do not independently prove a dated inscription or complete form sequence.
